notes: Development worlds 76001-76002 selected the fixed protocol; fresh worlds 76011-76013 were opened only after the aligned quality and payload gates passed.
The replay reran all methods on both aligned and independent worlds, checking 50 metric rows and exact serialized payload lengths.
Aligned teacher matrices were generated directly by Givens conjugation, so the result is a favorable mechanism screen rather than broad depth-sharing evidence.
The runtime uses eager matrix construction and is not optimized for inference.
